collections.title: ArduPilot tinkering
collections.heading: Micro-AGU: from a small parafoil to autonomous flight.
intro: Start with the flight story: early tests at Barrett Park in Hood River, tuning in a simple simulator, and autonomous missions at Collin’s house in Trout Lake.
Four chapters cover the build, the flights, steering, and longitudinal control. A shared appendix records the evidence; the related Plane trajectory study follows the navigation questions further.

pages.title: From First Tosses to Autonomous Missions
pages.description: Barrett Park → initial simulation → Collin’s house: measurements, fixes, tighter turns, and a 54.5-minute flight.

pages.title: Throttle, Pitch, and the Controller That Pushed the Wrong Way
pages.description: Flight identification, the wrong-sign damper, and the search for better canopy–payload control.

pages.description: Log provenance, parameter histories, measurement windows, model assumptions, and reproducible analysis.

pages.title: Can planning turns improve on L1?
pages.description: Line-to-line transitions, raster surveys and gust comparisons.

collections.note: The original controller flew the missions described here. Dedicated replacement controllers and observer designs remain simulation research. Flight measurements and simulation results are identified separately.
